critical_code_review_comments: services/notify.py: idempotency uses compare-and-set on orders.emails_sent ({$ne + $addToSet}) — correct pattern, immune to duplicate webhooks and parallel cron runs.

services/mailer.py: mode() re-evaluates env each call -> good; enables switching to live by just filling SMTP_* without restart of cron scheduling logic (still needs supervisor reload for env pickup in practice).

routers/cron.py: uses hmac.compare_digest -> good. run_id insert with DuplicateKeyError -> duplicate:true accepted -> good idempotency (assumes unique index on cron_runs.run_id — verify index exists).
notify.paid_async uses asyncio.get_running_loop().create_task and holds strong refs in _tasks set -> good (prevents GC-cancel race).
email_templates: HTML/text escape via html.escape -> good; total formatting 'Rp x.xxx' matches spec.
gateway.sync_pending returns list of order codes as 'checked'; cron.py summary maps list->len via `(len(v) if isinstance(v, list) else v)` -> good.

Minor: gateway.mock_complete triggers handle_webhook which in mock mode still calls mt.get_status inside handle_webhook — verify it short-circuits under mock (looks OK; verify_signature true in mock).
